name: Reze
description: Re:Anime Reze character package with independent left and right arm-hand layers.
notes: Left and right arm-hand poses are extracted individually from the supplied masked sprite sheet.
Touching two-arm gestures are preserved under hands/paired_reference/ because they cannot be honestly represented as independent layers without reconstructing artwork.
The package remains compatible with the Re:Anime state/pose compositor concept.
face/source_sheet.png preserves the original alpha-masked eye-expression sheet for reference.
Face expression PNGs are paired left/right eye tiles from the source sheet. Some asymmetrical states (such as wink) intentionally remain asymmetrical.
